Due to a permanent obstruction, there is no traversable path directly connecting Station Alpha and Station Beta. Furthermore, due to seasonal access restrictions, the planned route must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical links: the path between Station Beta and Station Gamma, or the path between Station Gamma and Station Delta.

The objective is to determine the shortest possible circuit that visits every station precisely one time and concludes at the point of origin.
